answer: A verifiable-delay admission gate starves sybil attacks of speed. Before an agent can earn anything, its identity must pass through a delay function taking fixed wall-clock time, like water melting through a glacier, and no extra hardware shortens it. An attacker wanting a haven of one thousand clones must wait a thousand sequential delay periods, not run them in parallel, since each identity binds to an independent seed. Established agents keep operating at violet-tier speed with zero waiting, so honest participants lose nothing while the attack stretches past any profitable horizon.
